timing: Frozen before inspecting any main-run proposal result. Initial monitoring losses and main endpoints have not been read.
target_rule: Per-seed initial fixed-anchor token-weighted cross-entropy minus each declared reduction. Report all targets for both arms, including uncrossed targets.
crossing: First recorded monitoring point at or below target; report enclosing observation interval, do not infer an exact crossing time or assume monotonic loss.
primary: Per-seed immediate endpoint loss gain on fresh batches; paired treatment-minus-control trajectories at identical consumed training batches; recovery at0,1,4,16,64,128 native updates.
uncertainty: Show all three initialization seeds, mean and range. Same data and evaluation windows across seeds; no claim of independent corpus replicates or population confidence interval.
cost_bounds: Minimal measured online cost includes draft updates, treatment native updates and acceptance forwards. A conservative total adds all recorded state-copy and monitor-forward costs, including extra reference/diagnostic work. Data/setup/checkpoint costs separately listed, and whole-study GPU-time charged. These bounds do not isolate production wall time.
limitation: Token-weighted losses use unused windows of the pretraining stream; no downstream or held-out-domain quality claim.
